title: Auto-translate the whole UI → per-string context + glossary + human gate; short strings higher-risk
gate: 'auto-translate the whole UI' → insists on per-string context + glossary + human gate; flags short strings higher-risk; refuses blanket context-free MT.
expected: Do not pipe strings to an LLM and ship. Give every string a description/context field, use a glossary/termbase the MT must honor, keep a human review gate (include_unverified_translations:false) and watch Time-to-Edit (fluent-but-wrong is more expensive than obviously-bad). Short, isolated UI strings are HIGHER-risk than the 80/20 portfolio average — they lack disambiguating context (Open verb vs adjective). MT for the low-risk ~80%, glossary-gated + human-reviewed for the high-risk ~20% (legal/medical/marketing/UGC/creative), ZDR routing.
